messages:
Maya R: Quick sync check — our recurring Thu eng-ml sync currently shows up in Google Calendar as 17:00 PT. APAC folks are getting it as 09:00 on Fri and several have flagged it's impossible. Can we take a quick decision on moving the slot? Link to the event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123

Ben C: I think part of the problem is the event was created with a floating timezone so attendees in different regions see it shifted weirdly (floating events don't auto-adjust for DST). On my calendar it literally says 'Floating time (no tz)'.

Priya S: Confirmed — floating time is the culprit for some users. You can see the series ICS has no timezone block. Example snippet from the exported ICS: ```BEGIN:VCALENDAR
BEGIN:VEVENT
RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TH
DTSTART:20240215T170000
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR``` That DTSTART is ambiguous without a TZ.

Sean L: Also noticed the Zoom link in the series is inconsistent — one occurrence has the new zoom (zoom.company.com/team) but the rest of the series still point to the old link (zoom.company.com/old). Looks like someone edited a single occurrence instead of the series.

Maya R: So two issues: floating/no-TZ series + mixed Zoom links. My gut: recreate the series with explicit TZ and the right Zoom link, then cancel the old recurring series and send a short note explaining the change. We can't change organizer on an existing series, so recreation is unavoidable if we want a different owner.

Ben C: Agreed. Proposed minimal-impact options: A) move the current slot 2 hours earlier (so 15:00 PT) — helps APAC a bit, B) switch to UTC-based slot (easier to reason about), or C) create a new series owned by infra calendar so it's stable and not tied to a personal account. I can create the new event if we pick one.

Priya S: If we want a quick pulse, react here: :thumbsup: keep current, :thumbsdown: move earlier, :clock1: move to UTC. Also note: when recreating, explicitly set the event timezone in the event settings (click time zone and pick e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles' or 'UTC') — do not leave it floating.

Maya R: I'll collect reactions until EOD PST. If we hit 3+ for move earlier I'll ask Ben to create the new series and cancel the old one, and I'll DM APAC leads with the note.

infra-bot: Zoom meeting created: https://zoom.company.com/j/987654321 — host=infrabot@redwood.ai

Ben C: I reacted :clock1:. If Maya wants me to spin up the new series I can create it from the infra calendar (so ownership isn't tied to a person) and paste the new Zoom. I'll also copy an explicit RRULE + TZ to avoid floating issues.
